service.en: Transport services for people of determination
service.ur: معذور افراد کے لیے ٹرانسپورٹ خدمات

about: Toll exemption, bus travel and taxi discount for people of determination.
note: Requirements read from the official Abu Dhabi Mobility page on the checked date. This service has no sign-in form of its own to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Darb toll exemption covers one vehicle in the person's name or a first degree relative's name
Public buses need a Hafilat smart card
Taxi: 50% off the fare for people of determination, the elderly and the disabled
channels: Taxi discount card through the Ministry of Community Development
